messages:
kyra_newhire: Hi team — quick logistics question for my first week (arriving Monday). Do I need to bring physical docs for the I-9, or can we do the remote verification? Also wondering if my laptop will arrive before I come in, and when benefits enrollment opens. Thanks!

marta_peopleops: Congrats and welcome, Kyra! :tada: If you're coming to the SF office in person on Monday you can complete the I-9 in person — bring one of the acceptable document sets (passport OR driver's license + SSN card). If you prefer virtual, we can set up an in-person verification appointment on the same day with a staff verifier.

kyra_newhire: Thanks — I do plan to swing by the office for orientation. If I bring a passport that's fine, right? Also do I need the paper offer letter or is the e-signed copy ok?

marta_peopleops: Passport is perfect. E-signed offer is fine; we only need ID docs for badge/I-9. Please bring your passport to reception and our verifier will sign off. Badge kiosk will take your photo.

julian_it: FYI I shipped your laptop today via internal logistics. Tracking: https://ship.redwood.internal/track/RY-8523 (should be delivered Fri after 3pm). If you arrive before delivery we can hold it at reception for pickup.

kyra_newhire: Awesome — can you leave it at reception? I'm landing late Sunday so will be in Monday morning.

julian_it: Yep — putting a sticky note on the package: "Kyra — hold at reception". Badge desk knows to release to you.

marta_peopleops: Quick heads-up on benefits and forms: benefits enrollment opens on your first calendar day (you'll get an email from Workday). You have 30 days to enroll in medical/dental/vision. If you want to preview plans, see <https://benefits.redwood.ai/2026|2026 benefits guide>.

kyra_newhire: Perfect. Any schedule for Monday? I want to block time.

marta_peopleops: Monday orientation 9:00am — Welcome + HR overview (Conference A). 10:00am — benefits deep-dive and Q&A with People Ops. 11:30am — IT desk for laptop/badge pickup. 1:00pm — manager intro + team lunch (if you're local). We'll DM you calendar invites.

marta_peopleops: For background checks: hr_bot, can you confirm status for Kyra?

hr_bot: Background check status for kyra_newhire: COMPLETED — no issues flagged. Criminal and employment verification returned clear. (Ref: BG-7721)

kai_ops: If you need ADA accommodations for orientation or travel assistance, please reply here or email people-ops@redwood.ai and we'll arrange.

kyra_newhire: Thanks everyone — all clear. One last thing: where do I park/any visitor passes?

marta_peopleops: If you drive, use visitor lot P3 and enter code REDWOOD-ORIENT when you check in at the gate. There's a shuttle dropoff (Lot B) if you prefer rideshare. We'll add the parking code and a short arrival map to your calendar invite.

marta_peopleops: Quick checklist for Monday (copyable):
```
- Bring passport OR DL + SSN card
- Bring e-signed offer (electronic copy ok)
- Laptop: track delivery, pickup at reception if needed
- Benefits: watch for Workday invite (30-day window)
- Orientation: 9am HR, 10am benefits, 11:30am IT, 1pm manager/team
- Parking: P3 visitor lot (code: REDWOOD-ORIENT)
```

kyra_newhire: This is super helpful — see you Monday! :raised_hands: 

julian_it: Ping me in the morning if you need help logging in, I'll be at the IT desk until 2pm.

marta_peopleops: Welcome aboard again — we'll DM any last-minute changes. 

hr_bot: Reminder scheduled: "Welcome + benefits email" will send to kyra_newhire at 08:00 local on Monday.
